_owner: Track D writes the catalog; Track C consumes it. Needs only, never diagnoses.
_fields: needs[].adjustments → ids in adjustments{}. company_source = where Brightline already allows it (cite it), null if the company docs say nothing. legal = file names in data/legal/ without .md. how_to_ask is first person, describes the need and the change only.

needs.label: Long documents take me a long time

async-written-standup.title: Written async standup
async-written-standup.what: Post yesterday / today / blockers in the standup thread instead of speaking in the call.
async-written-standup.how_to_ask: I'd like to post my standup update in writing in the team thread before 10:00 instead of speaking in the call.
async-written-standup.company_source: Engineering Handbook > 3.2 Standup format (async standup is allowed)

captions-transcript.title: Live captions and a written transcript for team ceremonies
captions-transcript.what: Turn on captions in Google Meet for planning, refinement and retro, and share the transcript or notes afterwards.
captions-transcript.cost: $0 (Meet captions) to ~$0.22/hour for a transcription service
captions-transcript.how_to_ask: I'd like captions turned on in our team meetings and the transcript or notes shared afterwards.
captions-transcript.company_gap: Engineering Handbook > 4.3: only Pulse is captioned; team ceremonies are not recorded.

agenda-in-advance.title: Agenda and materials the day before
agenda-in-advance.what: Get the agenda and the tickets to discuss at least one working day before planning and refinement.
agenda-in-advance.how_to_ask: I'd like to receive the agenda and the tickets for planning and refinement the day before.
agenda-in-advance.company_source: Engineering Handbook > 3.1 Sprints (agenda posted the day before)

written-decisions.title: Written decisions and action items after meetings
written-decisions.what: Someone posts the decisions and who does what in the team channel after each meeting.
written-decisions.how_to_ask: I'd like the decisions and action items from our meetings written in the team channel afterwards.

chat-first-questions.title: Questions in chat during meetings
chat-first-questions.what: Ask and answer questions in the meeting chat; the facilitator reads them out.
chat-first-questions.how_to_ask: I'd like to ask my questions in the meeting chat and have the facilitator read them out.

vscode-nvda.title: VS Code set up for a screen reader
vscode-nvda.what: VS Code with screen reader optimised mode, accessible diff viewer and audio cues; NVDA or JAWS licence if needed.
vscode-nvda.how_to_ask: I'd like my development setup to support a screen reader: VS Code in screen reader mode and the licence I need.
vscode-nvda.company_source: Engineering Handbook > 7. Tools (internal tools should work with a screen reader)

live-share-pairing.title: Pairing through Live Share
live-share-pairing.what: Pair programming in each person's own editor (VS Code Live Share) instead of watching a shared screen.
live-share-pairing.how_to_ask: When we pair, I'd like us to use Live Share so I can follow in my own editor.

diagram-text.title: Text version of every diagram
diagram-text.what: Architecture and flow diagrams come with a text description or outline.
diagram-text.how_to_ask: I'd like diagrams we use to come with a short text description.
diagram-text.company_gap: ARCHITECTURE.md and docs/setup.md have images without alt text.

accessible-tools.title: Accessible internal tools
accessible-tools.what: Tools that do not work with a keyboard or screen reader are reported and fixed or replaced.
accessible-tools.how_to_ask: Some tools I need don't work with my screen reader; I'd like them reported as bugs and fixed or replaced.
accessible-tools.company_source: Engineering Handbook > 7. Tools (report in #it-help, counts as a bug)

focus-blocks.title: Protected focus blocks
focus-blocks.what: Blocks of up to 3 hours a day with Slack on Focus; no pings except incidents.
focus-blocks.how_to_ask: I'd like to keep focus blocks in my calendar where I'm not pinged except for incidents.
focus-blocks.company_source: Engineering Handbook > 4.2 Focus time and notifications

single-buddy.title: One main point of contact
single-buddy.what: Questions go to one buddy first instead of many people.
single-buddy.how_to_ask: I'd like one main person to go to with questions, so I don't have to follow many channels.

batched-notifications.title: Batched notifications
batched-notifications.what: GitHub and Slack notifications delivered as a digest a few times a day.
batched-notifications.how_to_ask: I'd like to get non-urgent notifications as a digest a few times a day.

voice-coding.title: Voice coding and dictation
voice-coding.what: Dictation for messages and reviews; voice coding tools (e.g. Talon) where useful.
voice-coding.how_to_ask: I'd like to use dictation and voice coding tools for part of my work.

ergonomic-hardware.title: Ergonomic hardware
ergonomic-hardware.what: Ergonomic or split keyboard, vertical mouse, standing desk.
ergonomic-hardware.how_to_ask: I'd like an ergonomic keyboard and mouse to reduce strain.
ergonomic-hardware.company_source: Workplace Adjustments Policy > 3. Examples of adjustments (equipment)

flexible-breaks.title: More frequent breaks
flexible-breaks.what: Short breaks every hour without having to explain them.
flexible-breaks.how_to_ask: I'd like to take short breaks every hour.
flexible-breaks.company_source: Workplace Adjustments Policy > 3. Examples of adjustments (schedule)

written-acceptance-criteria.title: Written acceptance criteria on every ticket
written-acceptance-criteria.what: Tickets assigned to me include acceptance criteria before I start.
written-acceptance-criteria.how_to_ask: I'd like the tickets assigned to me to include written acceptance criteria before I start.
written-acceptance-criteria.company_source: Engineering Handbook > 3.3 Definition of Done (acceptance criteria are checked off)
written-acceptance-criteria.company_gap: The repository has no issue templates, so many issues have no acceptance criteria.

extended-review-turnaround.title: More time for reviews and reading
extended-review-turnaround.what: Two working days instead of one to review a pull request or answer review comments.
extended-review-turnaround.how_to_ask: I'd like two working days instead of one to do and answer code reviews.

text-to-speech.title: Text-to-speech for documents
text-to-speech.what: A text-to-speech tool for long documents, specs and tickets.
text-to-speech.how_to_ask: I'd like to use a text-to-speech tool for long documents.

summaries-first.title: Summary at the top of long documents
summaries-first.what: Specs and RFCs start with a short summary and the decisions needed.
summaries-first.how_to_ask: I'd like long documents and RFCs to start with a short summary.

deferred-on-call.title: Later start on on-call
deferred-on-call.what: Join on-call later than six months, with more shadow weeks.
deferred-on-call.how_to_ask: I'd like more shadow weeks before I'm on call alone.
deferred-on-call.company_source: Engineering Handbook > 2.3 On-call (no on-call in the first six months, two shadow weeks)

written-runbooks.title: Step-by-step runbooks for every alert
written-runbooks.what: Every alert links to a written runbook with the first steps.
written-runbooks.how_to_ask: I'd like every alert I might get to have a written runbook.
written-runbooks.company_source: Engineering Handbook > 2.3 On-call (every alert has a runbook)
